title.label: Not clear on how to upgrade

content.label:
I like it so much on my iPhone that I ran out of free words for the week. The upgrade button shows up but it’s confusing on how to upgrade. So I went and bought a year subscription on the website using my gmail account ( I suppose I should have used my Apple account) but I also want to use it on my windows. So, here I am. Paid 144 for something I can’t use on my iPhone. 

I’ve emailed the support email. Waiting for refund or how to upgrade on iPhone.
